rules.W1: Week {week} does not exist: the year has {max} weeks at most.
rules.W2: Number {week} comes from a spreadsheet's default week calculation. The ISO week of this date is {expected}.
rules.W3: Week {week} uses the calendar year. The ISO year of this date gives {expected}.
rules.W4: {date} belongs to ISO week {week}, in a different year from the calendar year {year}.
rules.W5: The date {date} is outside week {week}. This date falls in {expected}.
rules.W6: The end ({end}) comes before the start ({start}).
rules.W7: The period runs over several weeks up to {endWeek} while only week {week} is filled in.
rules.W8: The mission spans two weeks. The week used is the one of the start date: {week}.
rules.W9: No date and no week: the need stays a draft to complete and is left out of the totals.
rules.W11: The start is beyond the entry horizon of {weeks} weeks.
rules.W12: Week {week} is closed. Only the agency can reopen it.
rules.W14: The date "{raw}" may have day and month swapped.
rules.W16: The start ({date}) falls on a non-working day.
rules.W17: The start falls mid-week: {days} days out of {of} in week {week}.
rules.W18: Period 2 starts on {start}, before the end of period 1 ({end}).
rules.W20: The mission starts before the entry date or outside the campaign window.
rules.W21: The seasonal need goes outside the campaign window ({start} to {end}).
rules.W22: Another need ({code}) of the same sector and type already covers week {week}.
rules.D1: Exact duplicate of need {code}: same sector, type, dates and hours.
rules.D3: The period is included in the one of need {code}, or the other way round. Probable duplicate or refinement.
rules.D4: The period continues need {code} without a gap. Extending the existing need is possible.
rules.D5: Store {store} is already in need {code} of another sector over the same period.
rules.D6: Same title as need {code} on another period. A recurrence is still possible.
rules.D7: This need is already present ({code}): update it instead of creating it.
rules.J1: None of the ticked days falls between {start} and {end}.
rules.J2: The ticked day ({weekday}) is a public holiday over the whole period.
rules.J3: {weekday} is not offered by this scheme.
